title: Does steering against one bias amplify another bias down the chain?

original_idea.body: Build a debiasing vector for one attribute and audit cross-attribute spillover on other biases before/after steering; curated template prompts; spillover matrix.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Bias spillover is a fairness/social-harm concern only vaguely linked to catastrophic AI risk; no specific catastrophic scenario (level 2).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Bias vector + paired-template spillover matrix on one open model; guided (level 4).

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped with clear success criterion (cross-attribute spillover matrix) (level 5).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Public model, curated prompts, externally runnable spillover audit (level 4).

low_compute.reasoning: Steering + inference, no training; single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Debiasing spillover studied; steering-specific matrix partly open; partially addressed.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Steering cross-bias spillover matrix may be partly open.
